qualification_unit: core cycles per exact repeated block
budgets_disposition: predeclared development budgets; not an assertion of achieved or maintainer-accepted accuracy
ranking_rule: Report every sign reversal for alternatives whose hardware difference exceeds the paired noise interval; no reversal is an acceptance requirement for a claimed ranking. Publish ties and excluded/unsupported cases.
split_rule: Assign exact bytes and variants to calibration or held-out before hardware evaluation. Calibration/uops.info tables cannot appear as held-out evidence. Report all excluded forms against the full family denominator.
